title: A Corpus-Driven SentencePiece Unigram Tokenizer for Sindhi: Design and Benchmark Against Fourteen Existing Tokenizers
abstract: arXiv:2611.20126v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sindhi is a low-resource Indo-Aryan language written mainly in an extended Perso-Arabic script. Several Sindhi tokenizers have been released on public model hubs, but they have not been compared with one another on shared data. We train SentencePiece Unigram tokenizers with byte fallback at four vocabulary sizes (32k to 150k) on about 1.10 million Sindhi sentences and a smaller, repeated Urdu, Persian and Arabic slice, from four public sources, and compare them with fourteen existing tokenizers on four evaluation sets: FLORES+, Sindhi Wikipedia, a news-derived sentiment corpus, and a contemporary news corpus. The metrics are fertility, single-token retention, UNK rate, byte-fallback rate, and round-trip character loss. At 64k, our tokenizer averages 1.147 tokens per word, against 1.208 for the best existing tokenizer and 1.512 for XLM-RoBERTa, and keeps 88.6% of words as single tokens. translated_abstract: 信德语是一种低资源的印度-雅利安语言，主要使用扩展的波斯-阿拉伯文字书写。目前已有多个信德语分词器在公共模型库上发布，但它们尚未在共享数据上进行相互比较。我们在来自四个公开来源的约110万句信德语句子，以及一个较小的、重复使用的乌尔都语、波斯语和阿拉伯语数据切片上，训练了四种词表规模（32k至150k）的带字节回退机制的 SentencePiece Unigram 分词器，并在四个评估集上与十四种现有分词器进行对比：FLORES+、信德语维基百科、一个源自新闻的情感语料库和一个当代新闻语料库。评估指标包括分词碎片率、单词单token保留率、UNK率、字节回退率和往返字符损失。在64k词表规模下，我们的分词器平均每个单词产生1.147个token，而现有最佳分词器为1.208，XLM-RoBERTa为1.512，且88.6%的单词被保留为单个token。在分词碎片率、单词单token保留率和UNK率方面，它（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首个针对信德语这一低资源语言训练了带字节回退的语料库驱动 SentencePiece Unigram 分词器，并在四个评估集上与十四种现有分词器进行系统基准对比，结果显示其在分词碎片率、单词单token保留率和UNK率等关键指标上优于现有最佳分词器。
en_tdlr: This paper trains the first corpus-driven SentencePiece Unigram tokenizers with byte fallback for the low-resource Sindhi language and benchmarks them against fourteen existing tokenizers on four evaluation sets, demonstrating superior performance in fertility, single-token retention, and UNK rate.
